step1.ptxt: SRS Airbag System Handling and Work Precautions (see )

atten3.ptxt: This service work includes operations that affect the SRS airbag, so always check the SRS airbag precautions before starting work.

step1.ptxt: Precautions when Measuring CAN Bus Resistance

step2.ptxt: When measuring the resistance of the CAN bus, turn the IG OFF, confirm that warning functions such as the key reminder warning system are not operating, and leave the vehicle for 1 minutes or more without operating the key or switches or opening/closing the doors before starting measurement. If it is necessary to open a door during inspection, open it beforehand.

atten4.ptxt: Operating the key or switches or opening/closing the doors causes the related ECUs to perform CAN communication, so the resistance will not settle at a constant value.

step2.ptxt: As a rule, perform continuity inspection by applying the tester from the back side of the connector.
If the tester cannot be applied from the back side of the connector, use a repair wire.
After soldering the repaired area, wrap it with tape.

item.ptxt: Always twist the bus (communication lines) when assembling. When doing so, do not leave a gap between CAN-H and CAN-L.
Keep the difference in length between CAN-H and CAN-L within 10cm.
Keep the untwisted portion at the connector connection within 8cm.

step2.ptxt: Do not make bypass connections at the repaired area.

atten3.ptxt: Making bypass connections causes the twisted wire to lose its characteristics.
